description: Narrow default capability set for the Syncra desktop shell (SYNCDESKTOP.md §6.3, docs/DESKTOP-ARCHITECTURE.md §5.3). clipboard-manager:allow-read-text is deliberately ABSENT: it is not granted statically and is switched on at runtime only when clipboard capture is opted in (K10, default off) — that runtime grant mechanism is F5-6 scope, not this turn's.
